paragraphs.text: And in those days the angel Uriel answered and said to me: ‘Behold, I have shown thee everything, Enoch, and I have revealed everything to thee that thou shouldst see this sun and this moon, and the leaders of the stars of the heaven and all those who turn them, their tasks and times and departures.
paragraphs.original: ወበጊዜሁ፡ ይቤለኒ፡ ኦሪኤል፡ መልአክ፡ ናሁ፡ አርአይኩከ፡ ሄኖክ፡ ኵሎ፡ ወከሠትኩ፡ ለከ፡ ኵሎ፡ ከመ፡ ትርአይ፡ ዘንተ፡ ፀሐይ፡ ወዘንተ፡ ወርኀ፡ ወመራኅያኒሆሙ፡ ለከዋክብት፡ ሰማይ፡ ወኵሎ፡ ዘያስተራኩም፡ ኪያሆሙ፡ ግብሮሙ፡ ወመንግሥቶሙ፡ ወጊዜሆሙ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ba-gizēhu yəbēlanī ʾUrʾēl malʾak nāhu ʾarʾayku-ka Henok kwəlo wa-kaśatku la-ka kwəlo kama tərʾay zanta ḍaḥay wa-zanta warḫa wa-marāḫəyānihomu la-kawākəbt samāy wa-kwəlo zayāstarākum kiyāhomu gəbromu wa-mangəśtomu wa-gizēhomu

paragraphs.text: And in the days of the sinners the years shall be shortened, And their seed shall be tardy on their lands and fields, And all things on the earth shall alter, And shall not appear in their time: And the rain shall be kept back And the heaven shall withhold (it).
paragraphs.original: ወበመዋዕለ፡ ኃጥኣን፡ ዓመታት፡ ይሠራዕ፡ ወእክለ፡ ዘርዕ፡ ይሠቀል፡ በምድሮሙ፡ ወበግብሮሙ፡ ወኵሉ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡ ይሠቀል፡ ወአዝመተ፡ ምድር፡ ይትዐጽው፡ ወዘርእ፡ ዘዕለቶሙ፡ ኢይትከሥት፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድሮሙ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ba-mawāʿəla ḫāṭəʾān ʿāmatāt yəśarrāʿ wa-ʾəkla zarʿ yəśaqqal ba-mədromu wa-ba-gəbromu wa-kwəlu lāʿla mədr yəśaqqal wa-ʾazmata mədr yətʿaḍḍəw wa-zarʾə za-ʿəlatomu ʾiyətkaśśat lāʿla mədromu

paragraphs.text: And in those times the fruits of the earth shall be backward, And shall not grow in their time, And the fruits of the trees shall be withheld in their time.
paragraphs.original: ወይትዐጾ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዘለፍሬ፡ ጽጌ፡ በላዕለ፡ ምድር፡ ወዕፅ፡ ይዕወር፡ ፍሬሁ፡ ወወይን፡ ይትዐጾ፡ ፍሬሁ፡ ወብዙኅ፡ ዘርዕ፡ ይሰየብ፡ ወይትከሐድ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-yətʿaḍḍo kwəlu zala-fərē ṣəgē ba-lāʿla mədr wa-ʿəḍ yəʿwər fərēhu wa-wayn yətʿaḍḍo fərēhu wa-bəzuḫ zarʾə yəsayyab wa-yətkaḥad

paragraphs.text: And the moon shall alter her order, And not appear at her time.
paragraphs.original: ወወርኅ፡ ይትዌላጥ፡ ሕገጊሁ፡ ወኢይትከሠት፡ በበ፡ ጊዜሁ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-warḫ yətwēllāṭ ḥəgagihu wa-ʾiyətkaśśat baba gizēhu

paragraphs.text: [And in those days the sun shall be seen and he shall journey in the evening †on the extremity of the great chariot in †the west] And shall shine more brightly than accords with the order of light.
paragraphs.original: ወበእማንቱ፡ መዋዕል፡ ይትከሠት፡ በሰማይ፡ ወይመጽእ፡ ዐቢይ፡ ድርቅ፡ ላዕለ፡ ድንኅ፡ ምሥራቅ፡ ሰማይ፡ ቅድሜሁ፡ ለመንበረ፡ ከዋክብት፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ba-ʾəmāntu mawāʿəl yətkaśśat ba-samāy wa-yəmaṣṣəʾ ʿabəy dərq lāʿla dənḫ məśrāq samāy qədmēhu la-manbara kawākəbt

paragraphs.text: And many chiefs of the stars shall transgress the order (prescribed). And these shall alter their orbits and tasks, And not appear at the seasons prescribed to them.
paragraphs.original: ወብዙኃን፡ መርሐ፡ ሐራ፡ ለከዋክብት፡ ይስሕቱ፡ ሥርዐተ፡ ዘትእዛዝ፡ ወይትዌላጡ፡ ፍኖቶሙ፡ ወግብሮሙ፡ ወኢይትከሠቱ፡ በበ፡ ጊዜሆሙ፡ ሎሙ፡ ዘሥርዕተ፡ ሎሙ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-bəzuḫān marḥa ḥarā la-kawākəbt yəsḥətu śərʿata zatəʾəzāz wa-yətwēllāṭu fənotomu wa-gəbromu wa-ʾiyətkaśśatu baba gizēhomu lomu zaśərʿta lomu

paragraphs.text: And the whole order of the stars shall be concealed from the sinners, And the thoughts of those on the earth shall err concerning them, [And they shall be altered from all their ways], Yea, they shall err and take them to be gods.
paragraphs.original: ወኵሉ፡ ሕገገ፡ ለከዋክብት፡ ይትዐፀዉ፡ ላዕለ፡ ኃጥኣን፡ ወያስተዐሰዉ፡ መንፈሰ፡ እምኔሆሙ፡ ለእለ፡ ቤት፡ ይነብሩ፡ በላዕሌሆሙ፡ ወያስሕቱ፡ ኪያሆሙ፡ ወይትገበሩ፡ አማልክት፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-kwəlu ḥəgaga la-kawākəbt yətʿaḍḍəw lāʿla ḫāṭəʾān wa-yāstaʿassəw manfasa ʾəmənnehomu la-ʾəlla bēt yənabbəru ba-lāʿlēhomu wa-yāsḥətu kiyāhomu wa-yətgabbaru ʾamālekt

paragraphs.text: And evil shall be multiplied upon them, And punishment shall come upon them So as to destroy all.’
paragraphs.original: ወይብዝኅ፡ እኩይ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ፡ ወመቅሠፍት፡ ይመጽእ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ፡ ለመጥፋዕተ፡ ኵሎሙ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-yəbzəḫ ʾəkuy lāʿlēhomu wa-maqśaft yəmaṣṣəʾ lāʿlēhomu la-maṭfāʿta kwəlomu
